name: Open lids, calm aperture
rationale: The rounded upper arc and closer lower lid make the two open strokes more deliberate while the tighter eight circle iris retains the company motif.
tradeoff: The heavier lid reads clearly at small sizes, though the separated corners still depend on a crisp silhouette.

name: Open lids, relaxed slit
rationale: A shallow upper lid and a gently rising lower curve create a calm narrow aperture with the iris visibly centered between them.
tradeoff: The open corners stay expressive, while the smaller aperture places the iris closer to the upper lid.

name: Sculpted lens, tapered lid
rationale: The filled upper lid tapers from a broad center into fine corners, leaving a spacious lower aperture and an intact eight circle iris.
tradeoff: The wide negative space feels light, while the narrower lid carries less app icon weight.

name: Sculpted lens, bold lid
rationale: A taller filled canopy and deeper lower curve turn the eye into a more sculptural mark while keeping the pupil and eight circles legible.
tradeoff: The strong upper mass holds at menu size, though it may feel heavier beside Comfortaa.

name: Soft capsule orbit
rationale: Flatter crown and base curves evolve the ellipse into a soft capsule orbit, preserving continuous enclosure around the eight circle iris.
tradeoff: The compact contour is steady at small sizes, with less natural almond character than a curved eye.

name: Open orbit
rationale: A small opening on the right turns the closed ellipse into an orbit path that suggests observation in motion while retaining the central motif.
tradeoff: The gap adds direction, though it can read as a tracking symbol at a glance.
